Tea Collection is a specialty retailer of children's clothing and apparel accessories, designed for infants, toddlers, and children. The proposed use at 1801 4th Street, Berkeley, CA, is a general retail storefront selling new, pre-packaged apparel and related soft goods (clothing, sleepwear, outerwear, and accessories) directly to consumers. The location will operate as a standard retail sales floor with associated fitting rooms, checkout/point-of-sale counter, and back-of-house storage/stockroom for inventory. No manufacturing, alteration, laundering, or on-site production of goods will take place; all merchandise arrives ready for sale and is stored and displayed on-site until purchase. Anticipated operations: -Retail sales to walk-in customers during standard commercial hours, seven days a week -Storage of packaged apparel inventory in a stockroom area -Point-of-sale transactions and customer service at a checkout counter -Fitting rooms for customers to try on merchandise -No food service, no on-site manufacturing, no equipment requiring special ventilation, and no hazardous materials use or storage The proposed use is consistent with general retail trade and is compatible with the existing commercial character of the 4th Street shopping corridor. Estimated employees on-site at peak: 3. Estimated square footage of leased space: 950 sq ft.
